text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the best part's just getting 
started! Too soon, too soon!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've got your present all ready! Look 
forward to—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not here either, right!? You haven't even 
looked at the present yet!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But stiiiill~~...! Your thoughtfulneeeess 
makes me soooo haaaappy~~...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, kinda figured you'd react like 
that. I was totally serious when I picked 
them out, though! Training socks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's super cute and practical! Save your 
tears for after you see it! Now smile, 
okay? Come on, say cheeeese.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... heheh♪ Yeah, I'm really looking 
forward to it!
